-- Phase 2: bodies for checked 64-bit signed addition.

-- Exact sum in arbitrary precision. Used only by the spec; never overflows.
sum_exact(a: int, b: int) -> bigint =
  post out == bigint(a) + bigint(b)
  ex sum_exact(a: 1, b: 2) == bigint(3)
  ex sum_exact(a: 9223372036854775807, b: 1) == bigint(9223372036854775807) + bigint(1)
  bigint(a) + bigint(b)

-- Returns the sum when it fits in int, None when it does not.
checked_add(a: int, b: int) -> int? =
  post out == None or out == a + b
  post out != None or sum_exact(a: a, b: b) > bigint(9223372036854775807) or sum_exact(a: a, b: b) < bigint(-9223372036854775808)
  ex checked_add(a: 1, b: 2) == 3
  ex checked_add(a: -5, b: 5) == 0
  ex checked_add(a: 9223372036854775807, b: 1) == None
  ex checked_add(a: -9223372036854775808, b: -1) == None
  -- Test each bound before adding, so the intermediate never overflows.
  -- MAX - b (b > 0) and MIN - b (b < 0) stay in range.
  if b > 0 and a > 9223372036854775807 - b
    return None
  if b < 0 and a < -9223372036854775808 - b
    return None
  a + b
